bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; candidate=$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:candidate-287937c) || exit 101; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$candidate" || exit 102; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 103; docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs -e 'const fs=require("fs");(async()=>{const token=fs.readFileSync(process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE,"utf8").trim();const r=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/getMe",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)});const j=await r.json();if(!r.ok||!j.ok||j.result.username!=="GayBBS_bot")process.exit(1)})().catch(()=>process.exit(1))' >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 104; code=0; for entry in '-1003847210571:116:1' '-1002373696859:1605:2' '-1003770334893:4:4'; do chat=${entry%%:*}; rest=${entry#*:}; thread=${rest%%:*}; bit=${rest##*:}; n=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND chat_id=$chat AND message_thread_id=$thread" 2>/dev/null) || exit 105; test "$n" = 1 || code=$((code+bit)); done; test "$code" -eq 0 || exit $((110+code));
